title: Tailwinds and Tides
meta_description: Home Highlights - Private Resort Style Pool and spa - Rooftop Deck - Game room with Pool table - Elevator - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
description_expanded: Home Highlights: • Private resort-style pool & hot tub (heat optional Oct 1–May 1, $60/day) • Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 • Rooftop deck with pergola & sweeping views • Game room with pool table, bar, and 4 big-screen TVs • Private elevator to all floors • 6 adult bikes & 6-seat golf cart included Your Coastal Dream Retreat in Seagrove Beach Welcome to Tailwinds & Tides, a stunning new construction nestled in the heart of Seagrove—one of 30A’s most beloved coastal communities. Here, sugar-white sands meet Old Florida charm, where you can stroll quiet streets lined with beach cottages, watch pelicans drift overhead, and take in sunsets that will stay with you long after your stay. First Floor – Entertainment Paradise Step through the grand double doors into your private game & entertainment lounge. Challenge friends to billiards, watch the game on four big-screen TVs, or grab drinks from the bar and beverage fridge. Floor-to-ceiling sliders open to your resort-style pool and spa, surrounded by swaying palms. The covered outdoor kitchen features a built-in gas grill, marble prep counters, sink, and another TV—perfect for poolside dining. A full bath, laundry room with double washers/dryers, and ample storage make this level as practical as it is fun. Second Floor – Open-Concept Living Ride the private elevator or take the stairs to a bright and airy main living space with plush seating, a modern fireplace, and balcony views over the pool. The chef’s kitchen boasts a Sub-Zero fridge, 6-burner gas range with custom hood, pot filler, oversized island, and crisp white tile accents. The dining area opens to a covered deck for coffee or cocktails outdoors. Sleeping Arrangements Second Floor - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with shower only - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom w/ Shower Only - Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen Bunks - Private Bathroom with shower only - Common Bathroom - Toilet Only Third Floor - Master Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only Why Guests Love It: Tailwinds & Tides is more than a vacation rental—it’s a private luxury resort designed for making memories. Whether you’re splashing in the pool, enjoying rooftop cocktails, or taking the golf cart down to the beach, every moment here is crafted for comfort and connection. Book your stay now and make Seagrove Beach your home away from home.
